title: Paneer Butter Masala
description: A rich and creamy North Indian curry made with paneer in a tomato-based sauce
steps: Cut paneer into cubes and lightly fry them
Blend tomatoes, onion, garlic, and ginger into a smooth paste
Heat butter in a pan and add cumin seeds
Add the blended paste and cook until oil separates
Add spices and cook for 2-3 minutes
Add cream and mix well
Add paneer cubes and simmer for 5 minutes
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves

title: Masala Dosa
description: Crispy South Indian crepe filled with spiced potato mixture
steps: Soak rice and dal separately for 4-6 hours
Grind them together to make smooth batter
Ferment the batter overnight
Boil potatoes and mash them
Heat oil and add mustard seeds, cumin seeds
Add onions, chilies, and curry leaves
Add mashed potatoes and spices
Cook dosa on hot tawa and fill with potato mixture

title: Chicken Biryani
description: Aromatic basmati rice cooked with marinated chicken and spices
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices for 2 hours
Soak rice for 30 minutes
Fry onions until golden brown
Cook chicken with tomatoes and spices
Parboil rice with salt and saffron
Layer rice and chicken in a heavy-bottomed pot
Cover and cook on low heat for 20 minutes
Garnish with fried onions and mint leaves

title: Rajma Masala
description: Kidney beans cooked in a rich tomato and onion gravy
steps: Soak kidney beans overnight and pressure cook
Heat oil and add cumin seeds
Add chopped onions and cook until golden
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook
Add tomatoes and cook until soft
Add spices and cook for 2-3 minutes
Add cooked kidney beans and simmer
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves

title: Pav Bhaji
description: Spiced vegetable curry served with buttered bread rolls
steps: Boil vegetables until soft and mash them
Heat butter and add chopped onions
Add tomatoes and cook until soft
Add spices and cook for 2-3 minutes
Add mashed vegetables and mix well
Cook for 10-15 minutes until flavors blend
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves
Serve with buttered pav buns

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Classic Italian pasta with eggs, cheese, and pancetta
steps: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions
Cut pancetta into small pieces and fry until crispy
Beat eggs with parmesan cheese and black pepper
Drain pasta and mix with pancetta
Remove from heat and quickly mix in egg mixture
Toss until creamy and serve immediately

title: Margherita Pizza
description: Classic Italian pizza with tomato sauce, mozzarella, and basil
steps: Preheat oven to 450°F
Roll out pizza dough
Spread tomato sauce evenly
Add mozzarella cheese
Drizzle with olive oil
Bake for 12-15 minutes
Garnish with fresh basil leaves

title: Chicken Fried Rice
description: Chinese-style fried rice with chicken and vegetables
steps: Cut chicken into small pieces and marinate
Heat oil and scramble eggs
Cook chicken until done
Add vegetables and stir-fry
Add rice and mix well
Add sauces and seasonings
Toss everything together and serve

title: Chicken Tacos
description: Mexican-style tacos with seasoned chicken and fresh toppings
steps: Season chicken with taco seasoning
Cook chicken until done and shred
Chop vegetables for toppings
Warm taco shells
Fill shells with chicken
Add vegetables and toppings
Drizzle with sour cream and cheese
Serve with lime wedges

title: Pad Thai
description: Thai stir-fried noodles with shrimp and vegetables
steps: Soak rice noodles until soft
Mix fish sauce, tamarind, and sugar
Heat oil and cook shrimp
Add eggs and scramble
Add noodles and sauce mixture
Toss everything together
Add bean sprouts and green onions
Garnish with peanuts and lime

title: Chicken Teriyaki
description: Japanese-style chicken with sweet teriyaki sauce
steps: Mix soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar for teriyaki sauce
Marinate chicken in half the sauce
Cook chicken until golden brown
Add remaining sauce and simmer
Cook until sauce thickens
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions

title: Falafel
description: Middle Eastern chickpea fritters served with tahini sauce
steps: Soak chickpeas overnight
Drain and blend with herbs and spices
Form mixture into small balls
Heat oil and fry falafel until golden
Serve with tahini sauce and pita bread
